import html # Predefined HTML template with placeholders INVITATION_FORMAT = """

{event_name}

{description_of_event}

Date: {date_of_event}

{notes_for_event}
""" def create_invitation_for_event( event_name: str, description_of_event: str, date_of_event: str, notes_for_event: str ) -> str: """ Generate a secure HTML representation of an event invitation. Parameters ---------- event_name : str The name or title of the event. description_of_event : str A comprehensive description of the event (may contain multiple lines and formatting). date_of_event : str The scheduled date for the event. notes_for_event : str Extra information or instructions provided by the user. Returns ------- str A string containing sanitized HTML for safely displaying the event invitation. """ # Escape all user-supplied content to prevent XSS safe_event_name = html.escape(event_name, quote=True) safe_description = html.escape(description_of_event, quote=True).replace("\n", "
") safe_date = html.escape(date_of_event, quote=True) safe_notes = html.escape(notes_for_event, quote=True).replace("\n", "
") # Render the template with sanitized values invitation_html = INVITATION_FORMAT.format( event_name=safe_event_name, description_of_event=safe_description, date_of_event=safe_date, notes_for_event=safe_notes ) return invitation_html.strip()
